title: The Fresh Handling Charge Raised where the Fresh Cabinet has been Shopped
content:
Where the coolers of an Unattended Micro Market Program market have been shopped at least once over the six months to the day the settlement is raised, trade at the fresh cabinet over that same half year brings a fresh handling charge into the settlement.

## The clause

1. Where the fresh cabinet was shopped at or above 6 times over the six months to the day the settlement is raised, and the coolers were shopped at least once over those six months, the fresh handling charge is the call-out charge printed against the market format apportioned by the share those fresh cabinet trips take of the fresh and chilled trips together.
2. Where the fresh cabinet was shopped below 6 times over those six months, and the coolers were shopped at least once over those six months, the fresh handling charge is the flat fresh share of 25 per cent of the call-out charge printed against the market format.
3. Where the coolers were not shopped at all over those six months, no fresh handling charge is made.

## Basis of the apportionment

The fresh-trip floor is 6 trips at the fresh cabinet over the six months to the day the settlement is raised: exactly 6 trips is at or above the floor, 5 is below it. The apportionment under the first line divides the fresh cabinet trips by the fresh cabinet trips and the chilled trips added together, and takes that share of the printed call-out charge.

*Hypothetical.* Nine fresh cabinet trips and eleven chilled trips over the half year, on a format printing a call-out charge of 185.00 USD, give a fresh handling charge of 83.25 USD, being the share nine takes of twenty. Had the fresh cabinet been shopped only four times with the coolers shopped at all, the charge would be 46.25 USD, being 25 per cent of 185.00 USD. Had the coolers not been shopped at all over those six months, no fresh handling charge would be made.
